Ambos líderes remarcaron la cercanía actual de ambos países y su sintonía en temas como la necesidad de regular las redes sociales, especialmente para los menores de edad, la defensa de la soberanía, el desarrollo de la IA y la relación comercial con China. Nuestra corresponsal Marina Colorado nos amplió la información del encuentro. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: An Ohio farmer facing $1 million in medical debt hoped a solar lease would pay $540,000 a year
item.description: In Ohio, farmer Wayne Greier's financial struggles intensified when a planned solar project fell through due to local resistance and new rules, leaving his family's renewable energy plans in jeopardy. item.title: Scientists develop eDNA markers to detect Burmese pythons in southern Florida waters
item.description: Scientists created novel eDNA markers to identify Burmese pythons from water samples across southern Florida. The study focused on various wetlands, waterways, and their connections to assess python distribution. Water samples were filtered and processed to concentrate pythons' eDNA for accurate detection. Challenges included the low density of pythons and possible environmental inhibitors in the water. Efforts are ongoing to refine detection methods and improve the understanding of python populations.
